title: Octopus wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- party hat cone -->
  <polygon points='50,8 34,36 66,36' fill='#ffcc00' stroke='#ff9900' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- hat stripes -->
  <polygon points='50,8 44,20 56,20' fill='#ff3366'/>
  <polygon points='40,28 60,28 62,32 38,32' fill='#ff3366'/>
  <!-- hat pom pom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='4' fill='#ff3366'/>
  <!-- hat rim -->
  <rect x='33' y='34' width='34' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff9900'/>

  <!-- octopus head (mantle) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#e040b0'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='46' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#f06ac8' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='52' r='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='52' r='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='53' r='3' fill='#1a0a30'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='53' r='3' fill='#1a0a30'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='51' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='51' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42,62 Q50,68 58,62' fill='none' stroke='#a02080' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tentacles -->
  <path d='M28,66 Q18,74 22,84 Q24,90 30,88' fill='none' stroke='#e040b0' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M34,72 Q28,82 32,90 Q34,94 40,92' fill='none' stroke='#e040b0' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42,76 Q38,86 42,92 Q44,96 50,94' fill='none' stroke='#e040b0' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50,76 Q50,86 54,92 Q56,96 60,94' fill='none' stroke='#e040b0' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58,72 Q62,82 58,90 Q56,94 50,92' fill='none' stroke='#e040b0' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66,66 Q76,74 72,84 Q70,90 64,88' fill='none' stroke='#e040b0' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tentacle suckers -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='82' r='1.8' fill='#f8a8e0'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='86' r='1.8' fill='#f8a8e0'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='88' r='1.8' fill='#f8a8e0'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='92' r='1.8' fill='#f8a8e0'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='92' r='1.8' fill='#f8a8e0'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='86' r='1.8' fill='#f8a8e0'/>

  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff80c0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff80c0' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
